Current eight pockets are unlimited slots; per-slot maximum999; mail pocket is not autosorted. These are defaults, not a claim that all configurations permit every quantity.

assertions.meaning: Bag can_add resolves item then performs pure finite capacity scan. Negative quantity raises, zero succeeds; unlimited pocket supplies one additional candidate slot per call.

Add scans same domain and writes each partial contribution before returning false if remainder exists; sorting occurs only on full success for configured auto-sort pockets. Remove consumes matching slots and compacts, can return false after partial removal.
